Is a player returning from a spell with no minutes?

Source: R/returner_adjust.R
returner_status.Rd

A player is returning on as_of when either:

  • he is still out: no minutes for at least gap_days before as_of, while his last club played at least club_matches matches since; or

  • he is back: his last such gap ended before as_of, and he has played fewer than window_minutes minutes since it ended. The gap counts only if the club he came back to had played at least club_matches matches in it and he had played for that club before the gap (so a transfer debut is not a return).

This is the same return rule as the panna#497 validity tests (respell() / build_hist() in pannaverse docs/reviews/panna-validity-2026-11/panna_validity_common.R), which is what the 0.85 in returner_adjusted_panna() was tuned on. Minutes count every competition in lineups, one row per (match, player), capped at minutes_cap (the lineups hold a few corrupt values in the tens of thousands). A player who retired or left the covered competitions stays "still out" indefinitely (19.7% of the 100,378 players seen since 2024, as at 2026-11-09), so filter to the players you are showing or predicting for before reading the share.

Usage

returner_status(
  lineups,
  as_of,
  gap_days = 60L,
  club_matches = 8L,
  window_minutes = 900,
  minutes_cap = 120
)

Arguments

lineups

data.frame with player_id, team_id, match_id, match_date (Date or ISO string) and minutes_played. Rows on or after as_of are ignored, so the result is as-at.

as_of

Date the status is wanted for.

gap_days, club_matches, window_minutes

The return rule.

minutes_cap

Minutes above this in one match are treated as this.

Value

data.table with one row per player seen before as_of: player_id, returning (logical), days_out (length of the current gap if he is still out, else of his last qualifying gap; NA if none) and minutes_since_return (0 while still out, even if he had an earlier return; NA if he never had a qualifying gap).
